message: Beta/final-candidate channel. Use for approved live field validation only; stable remains v2.2.0 until promotion.
releaseNotes: Managed GitHub/Tampermonkey updater hardened after independent review: numeric prerelease ordering fixed, OPEN UPDATE pinned, pre-run compatibility refresh tightened, start re-entry guarded, minimum supported version decoupled from latest, and stale/failed hold status clarified. PPE inspection logic remains unchanged from rc5.
